candidates.original_identifier: 1Audio Clip S1An advertisement call of a male Cope’s gray treefrog. This sound is depicted visually as the natural call in Figure 1A.
candidates.status: original audio only; does not count toward video requirement

candidates.original_identifier: 2Audio Clip S2A 10-s segment of a Cope’s gray treefrog breeding chorus. A 3-s excerpt from this sound is depicted visually in Figure 1B.
candidates.status: original audio only; does not count toward video requirement

candidates.original_identifier: 3Audio Clip S3A 10-s segment of comodulated noise. Comodulated noise consisted of two equal-amplitude narrow bands of filtered white noise centered on 1.3 and 2.6 kHz. Both noise bands were modulated with the same low-pass filtered (12.5 Hz cut-off) noise envelope. A 3-s excerpt from this sound is depicted visually in Figure 1C.
candidates.status: original audio only; does not count toward video requirement

candidates.original_identifier: 4Audio Clip S4A 10-s segment of uncorrelated noise. Uncorrelated noise consisted of two equal-amplitude narrow bands of filtered white noise centered on 1.3 and 2.6 kHz. Each noise band was modulated with a different low-pass filtered (12.5 Hz cut-off) noise envelope so that the two bands fluctuated independently. A 3-s excerpt from this sound is depicted visually in Figure 1D.
candidates.status: original audio only; does not count toward video requirement

candidates.original_identifier: 5Audio Clip S5A 10-s segment of unmodulated noise. Unmodulated noise consisted of two equal-amplitude narrow bands of filtered white noise centered on 1.3 and 2.6 kHz. The noise bands were not modulated with a low-pass filtered noise envelope. A 3-s excerpt from this sound is depicted visually in Figure 1E.
candidates.status: original audio only; does not count toward video requirement

candidates.original_identifier: Movie S2.An illustration of the sensorimotor model. In the simulation, 25 bats fly for a second at a distance of 40 m from the cave, emit echolocation, and respond according to their reflected echo to avoid collisions. The intensity of the echolocation of the focal bat (black) and other conspecifics (orange), as well as the echoes of the focal bat (green), are presented in the lower panel. The acoustic scene is presented from the point of view of the focal bat; the conspecifics it detects are marked with green stars, and its jammed echoes are marked with red diamonds. The movie is presented at a speed 18 times slower than in real-time.
